---
name: Feature request
about: Suggest an enhancement
title: "[feature] "
labels: enhancement
---

**The problem**

What are you trying to do that's hard or impossible today?

**Proposed solution**

What you'd like to see. Sketch the behavior, not necessarily the
implementation.

**Which layer?**

- [ ] Typst engine / templates
- [ ] The web editor
- [ ] Tooling / build / CI
- [ ] Docs

**Alternatives considered**

Any workarounds you're using now, or other approaches you weighed.

**Additional context**

Anything else — mockups, links, related issues.

> For anything non-trivial, opening this issue first (before a PR) lets us
> agree on the approach so your time isn't wasted. See `CONTRIBUTING.md`.
